main.name: main
main.prompt: Hi {customer_name}, this is a call about your order from {shop_name}. Press 1 to confirm your order, press 2 to cancel it, or press 3 to change the delivery address.
main.invalid_prompt: Sorry, that's not a valid option.
main.on_timeout_message: We didn't get your response. Goodbye.

options.label: Confirm order
options.message: Thank you. Your order is confirmed. Goodbye.

options.label: Address change
options.message: Sure. Our team will call you back shortly to update your delivery address. Goodbye.

cancel_reasons.name: cancel_reasons
cancel_reasons.prompt: Please tell us why you'd like to cancel. Press 1 if it's too expensive, 2 if you changed your mind, 3 if you found it cheaper elsewhere, 4 if you ordered by mistake, or 5 for any other reason.
cancel_reasons.invalid_prompt: Sorry, that's not a valid option.
cancel_reasons.on_timeout_message: We'll record this as cancelled. Goodbye.
